normalized.result: Yes, that matches what I'd want. I pasted in the messier version of the same link — the extra "www", the trailing slash, the tracking bits tacked on the end, and the jump-to-a-section part — clicked Save, and it still recognized it as the Rome bookmark I already had, kept my clean saved address, and didn't make a copy. That's exactly the sensible behavior I'd hope for, because when I copy a link from an email or somewhere it's often got all that clutter on it, and to me it's still the same page. Nicely handled.
